title: Daily digest: Cabinet sub-committee pushes land poolin | Krishi mela will be held for three days  | Energy Minister Assures Restoration Of P | Cyclones caused over ₹500 crore loss to
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Telangana Today / The Hindu / Deccan Chronicle
bullets_en: Cabinet sub-committee pushes land pooling, industrial land auctions to boost revenue.
Krishi mela will be held for three days instead of one day: Agriculture Minister.
Energy Minister assures restoration of power supply in cyclone-hit areas by today.
Cyclones caused over ₹500 crore loss to A.P. Energy Department, says Minister.
bullets_ur: Cabinet ki sub-committee ne revenue barhanay ke liye land pooling aur industrial land auctions par zor diya.
Krishi mela ek din ke bajaye teen din tak munaqqid hoga: Agriculture Minister.
Energy Minister ne Supply ke Cyclone-Hit Areas mein Today ke zariye Restoration Power ka yaqeen dilaya.
Toofanon se A.P. Energy Department ko ₹500 crore se ziada ka nuqsan hua, Wazir ne bataya
